source: Leitao, M. R. (2024). Artificial Intelligence, Humanization, and Health Beliefs. Doctoral dissertation, Georgetown University.

files.trust-by-domain.json: Study 2 (N = 106), Table 7: Doctor minus AI trust difference by medical-decision domain. Transcribed from the dissertation.
files.effects-by-study.json: Cohen's d by study, as reported in the dissertation text.
files.trust-by-recommender.json: Study 1 (N = 188): mean trust (0 to 10) in each of eleven recommenders, with 95% confidence intervals computed from the study data. Summary statistics only.

sharing: Published summary statistics only. No raw participant data in this repository.
